instruction: The file `/home/user/Desktop/assembled.brd` is the assembled board to process. Produce pick-and-place CSVs using EAGLE's bundled mountsmd.ulp. Save the outputs as `/home/user/Desktop/pnp_top.csv` and `/home/user/Desktop/pnp_bottom.csv`. Requirements: 1. Both `/home/user/Desktop/pnp_top.csv` and `/home/user/Desktop/pnp_bottom.csv` exist. 2. Header row equals `Name,Value,Package,X,Y,Rotation,Side` in each file. 3. Row count per file equals the number of top-side / bottom-side elements in `/home/user/Desktop/assembled.brd` (by mirror flag). 4. Refdes sets per file match the expected split between sides. 5. Every row's `Side` column matches the file (top/bottom).
